_purpose: docs/PLAN_BOGATE_STATYSTYKI.md Faza 6. Maps a raw DiscoveredEvent.competition string a provider actually emitted to the one canonical spelling every provider's fixtures for that league should share. Applied in discover.py:discover_events() before dedup, so the same real-world league never splits into two competition strings that (a) hash into two different EventRecord.event_id values and (b) need two separate entries in every other competition-keyed map (ESPN, SportDB, competition_tier_map).
_discipline: Exact-name pin only, no fuzzy match -- the same rule config/sportdb_competition_map.json, config/espn_competition_map_verification.json and config/competition_tier_map.json already follow. A name absent from this map passes through unchanged. Never add an entry that collapses two spellings which name genuinely different leagues just because they look similar: bare 'Superliga' is deliberately absent (Denmark and Romania both use it -- see the 2026-08-28 incident referenced throughout src/bet/api_clients/espn.py) and must stay two separate, ambiguous, unresolved strings rather than being guessed into one.
